business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Project-driven Engineering, Procurement and Execution (EPC) and turnkey electrical infrastructure company delivering end-to-end electrical and infrastructure projects across India, alongside specialized MEP works.
- Incorporated in 2009 as Artemis Electricals Private Limited; evolved from a product/OEM-oriented electrical solutions provider into a full-scale project execution and infrastructure organization, reflected in its 2022 rebranding.
- Deck-cited track record: 758 projects done, 143 clients satisfied, ~25 years of experience; ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certified.
- Diversified project base spanning government/public infrastructure (e.g. Delhi Police Headquarters), hospitality (Sahara Star Mumbai, Aamby Valley City, Juvana Resort & Spa - Gorakhpur), and township/commercial developments.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Corporate structure] Parent Artemis Electricals & Projects Ltd (incorporated 2009) is listed on both NSE and BSE; subsidiary AOETPL is the SPV executing the electronics manufacturing cluster project.
- [Board changes] Independent directors added: Dharmendra Kumar Jain (appointed Feb 2026) and Dhrutiharsh Satia (appointed Apr 2026); Shivkumar Chhangur Singh has served as CFO since April 2018 and as Whole-Time Director since December 2018.
